welcome.text:
Welcome to ConnectAfrik, {{userName}}!

Thanks for signing up. Your account is ready. Here’s what to try first:

• Finish your profile — photo and bio help people find you.
• Open your feed — see posts from your network.
• Explore the marketplace — buy and sell with the community.
• Join a group — connect around shared interests.

Go to your feed: {{feedUrl}}
Edit profile: {{profileUrl}}

{{helpLine}}— The ConnectAfrik team

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email
verifyEmail.preheader: Confirm your email to activate your ConnectAfrik account.
verifyEmail.headline: Verify your email
verifyEmail.lead: Click the button below to verify your email address and activate your account:
verifyEmail.footerFallbackLink: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
verifyEmail.text:
Verify your email

Click the link below to verify your email address and activate your ConnectAfrik account:

{{confirmationUrl}}

ConnectAfrik — Uniting Africans and the diaspora worldwide

This is an automated email. Please do not reply to this message.

signup.subject: Verify your email
signup.headline: Verify your email
signup.preheader: Enter this code to continue creating your ConnectAfrik account.
signup.headerSubtitle: One step left to activate your account
signup.codeHint: Use the verification code below. It expires in 10 minutes.
signup.ignoreHint: If you did not request this code, you can safely ignore this email.

login.subject: Verify your email
login.headline: Verify your email to sign in
login.preheader: Enter this code to verify your email and continue signing in.
login.codeHint: Use the verification code below. It expires in 10 minutes.
login.ignoreHint: If you did not request this code, you can safely ignore this email.

recovery.subject: Password reset
recovery.headline: Reset your password
recovery.preheader: Enter this code to reset your ConnectAfrik password.
recovery.headerSubtitle: Use this code to choose a new password
recovery.codeHint: Use the verification code below. It expires in 10 minutes.
recovery.ignoreHint: If you did not request this code, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.headerSubtitle: A security update for your account
passwordChanged.preheader: This is a security notice that your ConnectAfrik password was updated.
passwordChanged.headline: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.lead: Hi {{userName}} — this is a confirmation that the password on your ConnectAfrik account was just updated.
passwordChanged.boxBody: If this wasn’t you, reset your password immediately and contact support. Someone else may have access to your account.
passwordChanged.text:
Your password was changed

Hi {{userName}},

This is a confirmation that the password on your ConnectAfrik account was just updated.

If you did not make this change, reset your password immediately and contact support.

Account settings: {{settingsUrl}}

— The ConnectAfrik team

newLoginAlert.subject: New sign-in to your account
newLoginAlert.preheader: New sign-in from {{deviceLabel}}. If this wasn’t you, secure your account.
newLoginAlert.headline: New sign-in to your account
newLoginAlert.lead: Hi {{userName}} — we noticed a new sign-in on your ConnectAfrik account.
newLoginAlert.boxBody: Change your password and review active sessions. If this was you, you can ignore this email.

friendRequestReceived.subject: {{actorName}} sent you a friend request
friendRequestReceived.preheader: Accept or decline {{actorName}}’s request on ConnectAfrik.
friendRequestReceived.headline: {{actorName}} sent you a friend request
friendRequestReceived.lead: Hi {{recipientName}} — {{actorName}} wants to connect with you on ConnectAfrik.
friendRequestReceived.boxBody: Open your requests to accept or decline. You choose who joins your network.

friendRequestAccepted.subject: {{actorName}} accepted your friend request
friendRequestAccepted.preheader: You’re now connected with {{actorName}} on ConnectAfrik.
friendRequestAccepted.headline: {{actorName}} accepted your request
friendRequestAccepted.lead: Hi {{recipientName}} — you’re now connected with {{actorName}} on ConnectAfrik.
friendRequestAccepted.boxBody: Say hello, follow their posts, or share an update with your network.
friendRequestAccepted.text:
Friend request accepted

Hi {{recipientName}},

{{actorName}} accepted your friend request on ConnectAfrik. You’re now connected.

View profile: {{url}}

— The ConnectAfrik team

groupInvite.subject: {{inviterName}} invited you to {{groupName}}
groupInvite.headline: You're invited to {{groupName}}
groupInvite.lead: {{inviterName}} invited you to join {{groupName}} on ConnectAfrik.
groupInvite.hint: Open the group to accept the invitation and see posts, members, and upcoming events.

groupJoinRequest.subject: {{actorName}} requested to join {{groupName}}
groupJoinRequest.headline: New group join request
groupJoinRequest.boxBody: Review the request and approve or decline membership for this group.
groupJoinRequest.signOff: Thanks for looking after your group,
groupJoinRequest.text:
Group join request

Hi {{recipientName}},

{{actorName}} requested to join {{groupName}} on ConnectAfrik.

Review request: {{url}}

— The ConnectAfrik team

groupRequestApproved.subject: You’re now a member of {{groupName}}
groupRequestApproved.preheader: Your request to join {{groupName}} was approved.
groupRequestApproved.headline: You’re in {{groupName}}
groupRequestApproved.lead: Hi {{recipientName}} — your request to join {{groupName}} was approved.
groupRequestApproved.boxBody: Open the group to see posts, members, and conversation.
groupRequestApproved.text:
Group request approved

Hi {{recipientName}},

Your request to join {{groupName}} was approved.

Open the group: {{url}}

— The ConnectAfrik team

groupRequestRejected.subject: Your request to join {{groupName}} was declined
groupRequestRejected.preheader: Your request to join {{groupName}} was not approved.
groupRequestRejected.headline: Join request not approved
groupRequestRejected.lead: Hi {{recipientName}} — your request to join {{groupName}} was declined.
groupRequestRejected.boxBody: You can browse other groups or request again later if the group allows it.
groupRequestRejected.text:
Group request declined

Hi {{recipientName}},

Your request to join {{groupName}} was declined. You can request again later if the group allows it.

View group: {{url}}

— The ConnectAfrik team

reportReceived.subject: New report received
reportReceived.headline: A new report needs review
reportReceived.lead: Hi {{adminName}} — a post was reported on ConnectAfrik and is waiting in the moderation queue.
reportReceived.boxBody: Open the report to keep, remove, or take action on the account.

accountSuspended.subject: Your ConnectAfrik account has been suspended
accountSuspended.headerSubtitle: Access to ConnectAfrik is currently restricted
accountSuspended.preheader: Your account is restricted. Contact support if you need help.
accountSuspended.headline: Your account has been suspended
accountSuspended.lead: Hi {{userName}} — your ConnectAfrik account has been suspended and you cannot sign in right now.
accountSuspended.fallbackBoxBody: Your account does not currently follow ConnectAfrik community guidelines. You won’t be able to sign in until a moderator restores access.

accountReactivated.subject: Your ConnectAfrik account has been reactivated
accountReactivated.preheader: Your account is active again. You can sign in as usual.
accountReactivated.headline: Your account is active again
accountReactivated.lead: Hi {{userName}} — your ConnectAfrik account has been restored. You can sign in and use the community as usual.
accountReactivated.boxBody: Please continue to follow community guidelines so your account stays in good standing.
accountReactivated.text:
Account reactivated

Hi {{userName}},

Your ConnectAfrik account has been restored. You can sign in again.

Sign in: {{signinUrl}}

— The ConnectAfrik team

orderConfirmation.subject: Payment received · Order {{orderNumber}}
orderConfirmation.preheader: We’ve got your order {{orderNumber}}. The seller has been notified.
orderConfirmation.headline: Thanks, {{buyerName}} — you’re all set
orderConfirmation.leadHtml: We’ve received your payment for order {{orderNumber}}. The seller has been notified and will work on fulfilling it.
orderConfirmation.boxBody: The seller will prepare your package. When it ships, you’ll see updates here — and you can always check status in My orders.
orderConfirmation.recordsNote: Save this email for your records.
orderConfirmation.text:
Payment received — order {{orderNumber}}

Hi {{buyerName}},

Thanks for your purchase. We’ve received your payment and shared the details with the seller.

What you ordered
• {{productTitle}} × {{quantity}}

Paid
• {{amount}} — successful

What happens next
• The seller prepares your order
• You’ll get tracking or updates when it ships
• Track everything in My Orders: {{ordersUrl}}

{{helpLine}}Thank you for supporting sellers on ConnectAfrik.

— The ConnectAfrik team

orderReceived.subject: New sale · Order {{orderNumber}}
orderReceived.headerSubtitle: A new order is waiting for you
orderReceived.preheader: {{buyerName}} purchased {{productTitle}}. Open your dashboard to fulfill it.
orderReceived.headline: You’ve got a new order, {{sellerName}}
orderReceived.lead: Nice work — someone just bought from your shop. Here’s what you need at a glance.
orderReceived.boxBody: Confirm shipping details with your buyer if needed, pack the order carefully, and mark it as shipped when it’s on the way so they can track it.
orderReceived.automatedSellerNote: This is an automated message about activity on your seller account.

orderStatus.signOff: Thank you for shopping with ConnectAfrik,

confirmed.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} confirmed
confirmed.headerSubtitle: The seller is getting it ready
confirmed.headline: Your order has been confirmed
confirmed.leadHtml: The seller confirmed order {{orderNumber}} and will start preparing it.
confirmed.next: You’ll get another email when your order is on the way.
confirmed.preheader: Order {{orderNumber}} is confirmed. The seller is preparing it.

processing.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} is being prepared
processing.headline: Your order is being prepared
processing.next: You’ll get tracking or shipping updates as soon as it leaves.

shipped.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} has shipped
shipped.headerSubtitle: Your package is on the way
shipped.headline: Your order is on the way
shipped.next: Watch for delivery, then confirm you received it in My orders.

out_for_delivery.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} is out for delivery
out_for_delivery.headerSubtitle: Your package is on the way today
out_for_delivery.headline: Your order is out for delivery
out_for_delivery.next: Please be available to receive it. You’ll get another update when it’s marked delivered.

delivered.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} delivered
delivered.headline: Your order has been delivered
delivered.next: If anything is missing or damaged, open the order and start a dispute.

completed.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} completed
completed.headerSubtitle: Thank you for shopping with us
completed.headline: Your order is complete
completed.leadHtml: Order {{orderNumber}} is marked as complete. We hope you love it.
completed.next: You can review the order anytime from My orders.

cancelled.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} cancelled
cancelled.headerSubtitle: This order will not be fulfilled
cancelled.headline: Your order was cancelled
cancelled.leadHtml: Order {{orderNumber}} has been cancelled. If you paid, a refund will follow according to the payment method.
cancelled.next: Check My orders for refund progress, or contact support if you need help.

refund_initiated.subject: Refund started for order {{orderNumber}}
refund_initiated.headline: Your refund has been initiated
refund_initiated.leadHtml: We’ve started a refund for order {{orderNumber}}.
refund_initiated.next: You’ll get another email when the refund is completed. Timing then depends on your payment provider.
refund_initiated.preheader: A refund for order {{orderNumber}} has been started.

refunded.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} refunded
refunded.headline: Your order was refunded
refunded.leadHtml: A refund has been issued for order {{orderNumber}}.
refunded.next: Refund timing depends on your payment provider. Details are in My orders.

fallback.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} updated · {{statusLabel}}
fallback.headline: Your order status is now {{statusLabel}}
fallback.next: Open My orders for the latest details.

successful.subject: Payment successful
successful.headline: Your payment went through
successful.lead: We’ve received {{amount}}{{orderBit}}. Thank you for shopping on ConnectAfrik.
successful.next: The seller has been notified and will start preparing your order.

failed.subject: Payment failed
failed.headerSubtitle: We could not complete this charge
failed.headline: Your payment did not go through
failed.lead: We could not collect {{amount}}{{orderBit}}. No charge was completed.
failed.next: Try another payment method or check with your bank, then complete checkout again.

pending.subject: Payment pending
pending.headline: Your payment is still pending
pending.lead: We’re waiting to confirm {{amount}}{{orderBit}}. This can take a few minutes.
pending.next: We’ll email you when the payment succeeds or fails. You don’t need to pay again unless we ask.

refundInitiated.subject: Refund started · Order {{orderNumber}}
refundInitiated.preheader: A refund for order {{orderNumber}} has been started.
refundInitiated.headline: Your refund has been started
refundInitiated.leadHtml: Hi {{buyerName}} — we’ve started a refund of {{amount}} for order {{orderNumber}}.
refundInitiated.boxBody: You’ll get another email when the refund is completed. Timing then depends on your bank or payment provider.

refundCompleted.subject: Refund completed · Order {{orderNumber}}
refundCompleted.headerSubtitle: The money is on the way back
refundCompleted.preheader: Your refund for order {{orderNumber}} is complete.
refundCompleted.headline: Your refund is complete
refundCompleted.leadHtml: Hi {{buyerName}} — {{amount}} has been refunded for order {{orderNumber}}.
refundCompleted.boxBody: The refund has been sent to your original payment method. It can take a few business days to appear, depending on your bank.

sellerPayout.subject: Your seller payout has been processed
sellerPayout.preheader: Your ConnectAfrik payout is on the way to your account.
sellerPayout.headline: Your payout has been processed
sellerPayout.lead: Hi {{sellerName}} — {{amount}} is on the way to your connected payout account.
sellerPayout.boxBody: Bank timing varies. Check your Stripe or payout account if the funds have not arrived after a few business days.

sellerPayoutFailed.subject: Your seller payout could not be completed
sellerPayoutFailed.headerSubtitle: Action needed on your seller account
sellerPayoutFailed.preheader: We could not complete your payout. Please check your payout settings.
sellerPayoutFailed.headline: Your payout could not be completed
sellerPayoutFailed.lead: Hi {{sellerName}} — we could not send {{amount}} to your payout account.
sellerPayoutFailed.defaultFailureReason: The payout transfer could not be completed.

newReviewReceived.subject: {{reviewerName}} left you a review
newReviewReceived.headline: You received a new review

orderReviewRequest.subject: How was your order {{orderNumber}}?
orderReviewRequest.headline: How was your order?
orderReviewRequest.lead: Hi {{buyerName}} — if everything arrived as expected, a short review helps other buyers and the seller.
orderReviewRequest.boxBody: Rate the product and share what you liked — or what could be better.
orderReviewRequest.signOff: Thank you for shopping with ConnectAfrik,
orderReviewRequest.text:
How was your order?

Hi {{buyerName}},

If everything arrived as expected, a short review of {{productTitle}} (order {{orderNumber}}) helps other buyers and the seller.

Leave a review: {{url}}

— The ConnectAfrik team

announcement.lead: Hi {{recipientName}} — an important update from ConnectAfrik.

author.subject: Your post is live
author.headerSubtitle: Your update is now in the feed
author.preheader: Tap to view your post and share it with your network.
author.headline: Your post reached your whole community.
author.lead: It’s on your profile and in your followers’ feeds. Here’s a quick preview.
author.hint: Share the link, or keep the conversation going in the comments.
author.statusFooter: Now visible on your profile and spreading through your followers' feeds.

friend.subject: {{authorName}} shared a new post
friend.headline: {{authorName}} shared something new
friend.lead: Open the post to read the full update and join the conversation.
